reference_sql:
WITH user_paid AS (  -- one row per user with a payment in 2025 that was not refunded
  SELECT s.user_id, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS paid_eur
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
quartiles AS (  -- one row per user, with its quartile
  SELECT user_id, paid_eur,
         NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY paid_eur DESC, user_id) AS quartile
  FROM user_paid
)
SELECT quartile, COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(paid_eur) / SUM(SUM(paid_eur)) OVER (), 1) AS paid_share_pct
FROM quartiles
GROUP BY quartile

WITH user_paid AS (  -- one row per user with a payment in 2025 that was not refunded
  SELECT s.user_id, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS paid_eur
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
quartiles AS (  -- one row per user, with its quartile
  SELECT user_id, paid_eur,
         NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY paid_eur DESC, user_id) AS quartile
  FROM user_paid
),
totals AS (  -- one row: the total of all these users
  SELECT SUM(paid_eur) AS all_paid FROM user_paid
)
SELECT qq.quartile, COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(qq.paid_eur) / MAX(t.all_paid), 1) AS paid_share_pct
FROM quartiles qq
CROSS JOIN totals t
GROUP BY qq.quartile

solver.query:
WITH tot AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS total
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY s.user_id
), g AS (
  SELECT user_id, total,
         NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC, user_id ASC) AS quartile
  FROM tot
)
SELECT quartile, COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total) / SUM(SUM(total)) OVER (), 1) AS paid_share_pct
FROM g
GROUP BY quartile
